name: sipantar
description: SIPANTAR - Sistem Informasi Pantau Harga Pasar

scripts.build: node -e "require('child_process').execSync('if exist .buildrc.json (echo Build already running) else (echo 1 > .buildrc.json && cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e \"const fs=require('fs');!fs.existsSync('backend/dist')&&fs.mkdirSync('backend/dist',{recursive:true});const src='frontend/dist';const dst='backend/dist';fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});const copy=(s,d)=>{const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');if(!fs.existsSync(s))return;fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(s).forEach(f=>{const sp=path.join(s,f),dp=path.join(d,f);fs.lstatSync(sp).isDirectory()?copy(sp,dp):fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)});};copy(src,dst); && cd backend && npm install && cd .. && rm -f .buildrc.json)" 2>&1

author: SIPANTAR Team
